calls.thesis: First tracked Hogue PATH call, in his seven stocks to buy for the post-AI-bubble world (staged buying: a little now, add every month or two, keep cash for a crash): UiPath is moving from repetitive-task automation into AI agents that interpret information and complete workflows, without spending billions on models or data centres; already $370M+ operating cash flow, $360M+ free cash flow and $619M cash, so it can survive a financing dry-up; risk is its original automation being made obsolete by Microsoft/OpenAI-type competitors.
calls.price_at_call: Down ~18% over the last year; analyst average target $15.57 (~20% upside) as stated
